senses.title: The medium of exchange in an economy
senses.definition: whatever a society accepts as the standard means of paying for goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会接受的、支付商品与服务的标准手段
senses.example: Trade needs a stable currency.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易需要稳定的货币。
senses.why: The economic function is the flow itself: currency is what runs between buyer and seller so that goods can move the other way.
senses.whyCN: 经济功能就是那道流动本身：currency 是在买卖双方之间流动的东西，好让货物反向移动。

senses.title: A particular national money unit
senses.definition: one country's money, treated as a countable unit when comparing countries
senses.definitionCN: 把一国的钱当作可数单位，用于国家之间比较
senses.example: The yen is a strong currency this year.
senses.exampleCN: 日元今年是一种强势货币。
senses.why: Different rivers can be compared. When money is counted by country, currency becomes countable: the dollar, the yen, the euro.
senses.whyCN: 不同的河可以比较。当货币按国家计数时，currency 就变成可数名词：美元、日元、欧元。

senses.title: Foreign currency and exchange
senses.definition: money from another country, especially in the context of exchanging one currency for another
senses.definitionCN: 别国的钱，尤指在把一种货币换成另一种的语境中
senses.example: She exchanged dollars for local currency.
senses.exampleCN: 她把美元换成了当地货币。
senses.why: Two flows meet at a counter. The exchange rate measures how much of one river equals a unit of another.
senses.whyCN: 两条河流在柜台相遇。汇率衡量的是：一条河的多少水量等于另一条河的一个单位。

senses.title: Digital and crypto currency
senses.definition: money that exists only electronically, including cryptocurrencies that are not issued by a state
senses.definitionCN: 只以电子形式存在的钱，包括不由国家发行的加密货币
senses.example: Regulators are studying digital currency and how such currencies settle.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构正在研究数字货币，以及这类货币如何清算。
senses.why: Value still circulates, but the channel is now digital. The old flow image survives even when there is no paper in anyone's hand.
senses.whyCN: 价值仍在流通，但通道变成了数字的。即使没有任何人手里拿着纸钞，古老的流动意象仍然存在。

senses.title: Of ideas: gain currency
senses.definition: in the phrase gain currency, to become widely believed or accepted
senses.definitionCN: 短语 gain currency 表示开始被广泛相信或接受
senses.example: The theory gained currency in the 1990s.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论在 20 世纪 90 年代开始流行。
senses.why: The flow metaphor moves from money to ideas. A belief that circulates from mind to mind has 'gained currency', as if it were coin passing through many hands.
senses.whyCN: 流动比喻从钱移到观念。一个在人脑之间流通的信念就算 gain currency，仿佛它是经过许多只手的硬币。

senses.title: State of being current or valid
senses.definition: the quality of being up to date, still in force, or still accepted as valid
senses.definitionCN: 仍然跟得上现在、仍然有效、仍被认可的性质
senses.example: The report questions the currency of the data.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告质疑这些数据是否仍然有效。
senses.why: If money is out of circulation it is no longer money; if data is out of circulation it is no longer current. The root sense 'being in flow' becomes 'being valid now'.
senses.whyCN: 钱退出流通就不再是钱；数据退出流通就不再 current（有效）。词根“处在流动中”由此变成“此刻仍有效”。

senses.title: Reserve and hard currency
senses.definition: a strong currency that is widely held, traded, and trusted, such as a reserve currency
senses.definitionCN: 被广泛持有、交易和信任的强势货币，如储备货币
senses.example: The dollar remains the world's main reserve currency.
senses.exampleCN: 美元仍是世界上主要的储备货币。
senses.why: A currency that many countries keep is a river that everyone depends on. 'Hard' means it does not lose value quickly, so the flow is reliable.
senses.whyCN: 许多国家都存着的那种货币，是所有人都依赖的一条河。“硬”意味着它不会迅速贬值，所以流动可靠。

intro.en: Currency is a flowing word. Latin currere 'to run' gives current, course, courier and curriculum as well; money is 'currency' because it circulates, and ideas 'gain currency' by circulating too.
intro.cn: currency 是一个“流动”词。拉丁语 currere“跑”也给出 current、course、courier、curriculum；钱被称为 currency，是因为它流通；观念 gain currency，也是因为它在流通。

items.en: First recorded meaning 'state of being current, circulation'. The financial sense 'money in circulation' appears in the 1690s.
items.cn: 17 世纪 50 年代最早记录，意为“处于流通中的状态”。财政义“流通中的钱”见于 17 世纪 90 年代。

items.en: From Latin currentia 'a flowing', from currens, present participle of currere 'to run'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 currentia“流动”，出自 currens，即 currere“跑”的现在分词。

items.en: currere is traced to PIE *kers- 'to run'. The reconstruction is generally accepted.
items.cn: currere 被追溯到原始印欧语 *kers-“跑”。该重构属于一般认为是。

items.en: The adjective current 'running, flowing' enters English earlier (15c.) and is applied to water, time and later electricity. The noun currency follows in the 17c.
items.cn: 形容词 current“流动的”更早进入英语（15 世纪），用于水、时间，后来用于电流。名词 currency 随后在 17 世纪出现。

items.en: National currencies, foreign exchange, hard currency and reserve currency become standard financial terms.
items.cn: 国家货币、外汇、硬通货和储备货币成为标准金融术语。

items.en: The idea sense 'gain currency' is common by the 19c.; 'currency of data' keeps the same root meaning of being in circulation and therefore valid.
items.cn: 观念义 gain currency 在 19 世纪已常见；currency of data 保留同一个词根含义：仍在流通，因而有效。

note.en: The first group shares currere 'run'; the second group separates money, cash, legal tender and circulation.
note.cn: 第一组共享 currere“跑”；第二组区分钱、现金、法定货币和流通。

entries.definition: the flow of water, air, or electricity; also 'happening now'. It is the adjective behind currency.
entries.definitionCN: 水、空气或电流的流动；也指“当前的”。它是 currency 背后的形容词。

entries.definition: a course of study, literally 'a running'. It shares currere.
entries.definitionCN: 课程体系，字面义“一段跑道”。它共享 currere。

entries.definition: a person who carries messages or parcels. It comes from currere 'to run'.
entries.definitionCN: 信使；快递员。它来自 currere“跑”。

entries.definition: anything generally accepted as payment. It is broader than currency and does not imply a state system.
entries.definitionCN: 被普遍接受为支付手段的任何东西。它比 currency 宽泛，不暗示国家体系。

entries.definition: coins and notes in hand. It is one physical form of currency, not the system.
entries.definitionCN: 手中的硬币和纸币。它是货币的一种实体形式，而不是体系。

entries.definition: in legal tender, money a creditor must accept by law. It stresses legal force.
entries.definitionCN: 在 legal tender 中指债权人依法必须接受的钱。它强调法律效力。

entries.definition: movement through a system. It is the literal flow image behind currency.
entries.definitionCN: 在系统中的流动。它是 currency 背后的字面流动意象。

normalIntro.en: Real family: currere 'run' gives currency, current, course, courier and curriculum. All of them involve something moving along a path.
normalIntro.cn: 真实词族：currere“跑”给出 currency、current、course、courier、curriculum。它们都涉及某物沿着路径移动。

normal.en: currere means run. Money is currency because it runs through the economy; an idea gains currency because it runs from mind to mind.
normal.cn: currere 意为跑。钱是 currency，因为它在经济中跑；观念 gain currency，因为它在人脑之间跑。

normal.en: Current, course, courier and curriculum all share the running root: a flow, a route, a runner, a course of study.
normal.cn: current、course、courier、curriculum 都共享“跑”的词根：流动、路线、奔跑者、一段课程。

normal.en: Hard currency does not leak value quickly, so its flow is reliable.
normal.cn: 硬通货不会快速漏掉价值，所以它的流动可靠。

normal.en: Foreign currency exchange is two rivers meeting at a counter, measured by an exchange rate.
normal.cn: 外币兑换就是两条河在柜台相遇，用汇率来量。

normal.en: Currency of data means the data is still in circulation, still valid now.
normal.cn: currency of data 指数据仍在流通、此刻仍有效。

abstract.en: Picture a river of coins running through streets and shops. It is the same water that keeps moving, only now it is metal and paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一条硬币之河穿过街道和商店。仍是同样的水在流动，只是现在变成了金属和纸。

abstract.en: Money out of circulation is a river dammed: it still exists, but it no longer does the work of money.
abstract.cn: 退出流通的钱是一条被截断的河：它仍然存在，却不再做钱该做的事。

abstract.en: An idea with currency is a rumour with a passport: it moves from person to person until it feels like fact.
abstract.cn: 一个 gain currency 的观念，是一则带着护照的传言：它在人与人之间移动，直到感觉像事实。

examples.en: The country introduced a new currency after independence.
examples.cn: 这个国家独立后推出了新货币。

examples.en: The idea that cities should be walkable has gained currency.
examples.cn: 城市应当适宜步行的观念已经流行起来。

examples.en: Traders watch how reserve currencies move against each other.
examples.cn: 交易员密切关注储备货币之间的汇率变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: “卡伦西”——卡伦西把钱包里的钱倒出来，像水一样流到兑换台 → currency 货币、通货

root: 拉丁语 currere“跑、流动”，名词 currentia“流动之物”，核心是“在市场上流动、被普遍接受的钱”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of currency, all one flow: a national money, a medium of exchange, a countable unit, foreign exchange, digital money, an idea in circulation, the state of being valid, and a strong reserve currency.
sensesIntro.cn: currency 的八个义项都是同一条流动：一国货币、交换媒介、可数单位、外币兑换、数字货币、流通中的观念、仍然有效的状态，以及强势储备货币。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: value runs through a channel, and whatever runs is accepted as money.
core.cn: 核心意象：价值在一条通道里流动，流动的东西被接受为钱。

branches.en: MONEY: circulating value, its exchange function, and each national stream.
branches.cn: 货币：流通的价值、交换功能，以及每一条国家之流。

branches.en: EXCHANGE: foreign streams meet at a counter, and strong ones become reserves.
branches.cn: 兑换：外币之流在柜台相遇，强势者成为储备。

branches.en: DIGITAL: the channel changes, the flow remains.
branches.cn: 数字：通道变了，流动仍在。

branches.en: IDEAS: a belief gains currency when it spreads from mind to mind.
branches.cn: 观念：一种看法在人与人之间传开，就算“流通起来”。

branches.en: VALIDITY: whatever is still circulating is current, which is why the root currere, to run, holds money, ideas and validity together.
branches.cn: 时效：仍在流通的东西就是“当前有效”的，因此表示奔跑的词根把货币、观念与时效系在一起。

intro.en: currency takes -cy to form a noun of state from current. The same -cy pattern appears in agency, tendency and efficiency.
intro.cn: currency 由 current 加 -cy 构成状态名词。-cy 这一模式也出现在 agency、tendency、efficiency 里。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on currere 'run': current, course, courier, curriculum and excursion all describe movement along a route.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 currere“跑”上：current、course、courier、curriculum、excursion 都描述沿路线移动。

items.meaning: flowing; happening now; a flow of water or electricity
items.meaningCN: 流动的；当前的；水流或电流（-ent 构成现在分词）
items.example: The current is strong after the rain.
items.exampleCN: 雨后水流很强。

items.meaning: at the present time
items.meaningCN: 目前；当前（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The bridge is currently closed.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥目前关闭。

items.meaning: a course of study, literally a small running track
items.meaningCN: 课程体系（字面义“一小段跑道”）
items.example: The curriculum includes two language courses.
items.exampleCN: 课程体系包括两门语言课。

items.meaning: a person who runs messages or parcels from place to place
items.meaningCN: 信使；快递员（跑动送件的人）
items.example: A courier delivered the documents within an hour.
items.exampleCN: 快递员一小时内送到了文件。

items.meaning: happening at the same time
items.meaningCN: 同时发生的（与 currere“跑”同根）
items.example: Two concurrent storms hit the coast.
items.exampleCN: 两场同时发生的风暴袭击了海岸。

items.meaning: a short trip out and back
items.meaningCN: 短途旅行（与 currere“跑”同根）
items.example: The class made an excursion to the quarry.
items.exampleCN: 全班去采石场做了一次短途旅行。

items.meaning: more than one kind of money
items.meaningCN: 多种货币（-es 构成复数）
items.example: The bank trades in several currencies.
items.exampleCN: 这家银行经营多种货币。

items.meaning: the path or direction along which something runs
items.meaningCN: 路线；进程（同出 currere“跑”）
items.example: The ship changed course at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 船在黎明时改变了航向。

latinEntries.meaning: a route, a series of lessons, or a direction of movement
latinEntries.meaningCN: 路线；课程；进程（一段跑动）

latinEntries.meaning: a short trip out and back
latinEntries.meaningCN: 短途出游（跑出去再回来）

latinEntries.meaning: to happen, literally 'run toward'
latinEntries.meaningCN: 发生（字面义“跑向”）

latinEntries.meaning: to happen again, to run back
latinEntries.meaningCN: 再次发生（跑回来）

definition_zh: 循环；周期；一轮；自行车；骑自行车；循环运行
definition_en: a series of events that repeats in the same order; one complete round; a bicycle; to ride a bicycle or move through repeated states
core_image: 车轮转过一圈，又回到同一个接地点
scene: 黑板上，四季被画成一个圆，箭头回到起点。 On the blackboard the four seasons formed a circle, and the arrows came back to the starting point, showing one cycle.
sceneCN: 这里 cycle 是「循环」（第 1 个义项：按同一顺序重复发生的一系列事件）；句意：黑板上四季绕成一个圆，箭头回到起点，正好是一个循环。

senses.title: A repeating series returning to its start
senses.definition: a set of events that happen in the same order and then begin again
senses.definitionCN: 按同一顺序发生、随后又重新开始的一系列事件
senses.example: The seasons form a cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 四季构成一个循环。
senses.why: Greek kyklos meant 'circle, wheel', from kykloun 'to circle'. A cycle is events arranged on a wheel: after the last one, the first one comes round again.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 kyklos 意为“圆、车轮”，来自 kykloun“绕圈”。循环就是把事件排在一个轮子上：最后一个结束后，第一个又转回来。

senses.title: One complete round of a process
senses.definition: one full run of a process from its start back to its start
senses.definitionCN: 一个过程从起点到起点的完整运行
senses.example: The washing machine finished its cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 洗衣机完成了它的一轮程序。
senses.why: The wheel image counts turns. One cycle is one revolution: fill, wash, rinse, spin, and then stop at the same starting point.
senses.whyCN: 车轮意象可以数圈数。一个 cycle 就是一圈：进水、洗涤、漂洗、脱水，然后停回起点。

senses.title: A self-feeding loop: vicious cycle
senses.titleCN: 自我喂养的循环：恶性循环
senses.definition: a repeating pattern in which each turn makes the next turn more likely or worse
senses.definitionCN: 一种重复模式，其中每一轮都使下一轮更可能发生或更糟
senses.example: Debt and borrowing form a vicious cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 债务与借新还旧形成恶性循环。
senses.why: A circle can become a trap when it feeds itself. Each turn of the wheel pushes the next turn, so the loop tightens instead of returning to rest.
senses.whyCN: 当圆圈自我喂养时，它就会变成陷阱。轮子的每一圈都推动下一圈，于是环越收越紧，而不是回到静止。

senses.title: Biological life cycle
senses.definition: the series of stages an organism passes through from one generation to the next
senses.definitionCN: 生物从一代到下一代所经历的一系列阶段
senses.example: Frogs have a life cycle with an aquatic stage.
senses.exampleCN: 青蛙的生命周期包含一个水生阶段。
senses.why: Biology arranges development as a ring rather than a line: egg, larva, adult, egg again. The wheel makes reproduction visible as a return.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把发育排成一个环而不是一条线：卵、幼体、成体、又是卵。轮子让繁殖显现为一次回归。

senses.title: Economic or business cycle
senses.definition: the recurring pattern of expansion and contraction in an economy
senses.definitionCN: 经济中扩张与收缩反复出现的模式
senses.example: Investment falls in the down phase of the cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 投资在经济周期的下行阶段下降。
senses.why: The ring is applied to the economy: growth, peak, recession, trough, growth again. The claim is not that the pattern is eternal, only that it repeats often enough to be named.
senses.whyCN: 圆环被用到经济上：增长、高峰、衰退、低谷、再增长。这不是说模式永恒，而是说它重复得足够频繁，值得命名。

senses.title: Thermodynamic or engine cycle
senses.definition: a sequence of changes in which a working substance returns to its initial state
senses.definitionCN: 工作物质经历一系列变化后回到初始状态的过程
senses.example: A heat engine repeats a four-step cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 热机重复一个四步循环。
senses.why: Technical thermodynamics defines a cycle precisely: the substance must come back to its starting pressure, volume and temperature. The wheel image becomes a measurable closure.
senses.whyCN: 技术热力学精确地定义循环：物质必须回到初始的压力、体积和温度。车轮意象在这里变成可测量的闭合。

senses.title: Bicycle
senses.definition: a two-wheeled vehicle driven by pedals; a short form of bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 靠踏板驱动的两轮交通工具；bicycle 的缩略形式
senses.example: She bought a new cycle for the commute.
senses.exampleCN: 她为通勤买了一辆新自行车。
senses.why: bicycle was coined from bi- 'two' + Greek kyklos 'wheel' in the 19c. English then shortened it to cycle, so the vehicle is named after its wheels, not after a repeating process.
senses.whyCN: bicycle 在 19 世纪由 bi-“两个”+ 希腊语 kyklos“轮”造出。英语随后缩略为 cycle，因此这种交通工具是按轮子命名的，而不是按循环过程。

senses.title: To ride a bicycle
senses.definition: to travel by bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 骑自行车出行
senses.example: She cycles to school every day.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天骑车上学。
senses.why: The verb comes from the shortened noun: to cycle is to use a two-wheeled machine. The round motion of the wheels is felt in the action.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自缩略名词：to cycle 就是使用一台两轮机器。轮子的圆周运动在动作里能感觉到。

senses.title: To move through repeated states
senses.titleCN: 循环运行：反复切换状态
senses.definition: of a machine, system, or process, to pass repeatedly through a fixed sequence of states
senses.definitionCN: 机器、系统或过程反复经过固定的状态序列
senses.example: The software cycles through three test modes.
senses.exampleCN: 软件在三种测试模式之间循环切换。
senses.why: The noun's ring becomes a verb of motion: the system goes round the sequence. Here cycle describes behaviour in time, not a physical wheel.
senses.whyCN: 名词的圆环变成运动动词：系统沿序列绕圈。这里的 cycle 描述时间中的行为，而不是物理车轮。

intro.en: Cycle is a wheel word from Greek kyklos. It names a circle of events, then one turn of that circle, then any machine that goes round — including the bicycle, whose wheels are the most literal part.
intro.cn: cycle 是一个来自希腊语 kyklos 的“车轮”词。它先命名事件构成的圆，再命名圆的一圈，然后命名任何绕圈运行的机器——包括自行车，因为轮子是它最字面的部分。

items.en: First recorded in English meaning 'recurrent period of time', borrowed through Latin from Greek.
items.cn: 14 世纪晚期最早记录，意为“循环往复的时间段”，经拉丁语从希腊语借入。

items.en: From Late Latin cyclus, from Greek kyklos 'circle, wheel, any circular body, circular motion, cycle of events', from kykloun 'to circle, go around'.
items.cn: 来自晚期拉丁语 cyclus，再上溯希腊语 kyklos“圆、车轮、任何圆形物体、圆周运动、事件循环”，出自 kykloun“绕圈、转”。

items.en: kyklos is traced to PIE *kwel- (1) 'to turn around, move around', also behind wheel and pole. The reconstruction is generally accepted.
items.cn: kyklos 被追溯到原始印欧语 *kwel-（第 1 义）“转动、绕行”，wheel 和 pole 也出自这里。该重构属于一般认为是。

items.en: bicycle is coined in the 1860s from bi- 'two' + Greek kyklos; English shortens it to cycle. The verb 'to cycle' follows.
items.cn: bicycle 在 19 世纪 60 年代由 bi-“两个”+ 希腊语 kyklos 造出；英语把它缩略为 cycle。动词“骑车”随后出现。

items.en: Life cycle, economic cycle and thermodynamic cycle become technical terms; recycle appears in the 1920s and spreads in the environmental era.
items.cn: life cycle、economic cycle、thermodynamic cycle 成为技术术语；recycle 在 20 世纪 20 年代出现，并在环保时代普及。

items.en: Modern English uses cycle for repetition, for one round, and for the bicycle. The same wheel image covers all three, which is why one short word can do so much.
items.cn: 现代英语用 cycle 表示重复、表示一圈、也表示自行车。同一个车轮意象覆盖三者，所以一个短词能做这么多事。

note.en: The first group shares kyklos 'wheel' or looks close; the second group separates circle, loop, rotation and rhythm.
note.cn: 第一组共享 kyklos“轮”或词形接近；第二组区分圆、环、旋转和节律。

entries.definition: a two-wheeled vehicle. It is literally 'two wheels' and the source of the short form cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 两轮交通工具。它字面就是“两个轮子”，也是缩略形式 cycle 的来源。

entries.definition: a rotating storm system. Greek kyklon meant 'whirling'.
entries.definitionCN: 旋转的风暴系统。希腊语 kyklon 意为“旋转”。

entries.definition: happening in a repeating pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 循环发生的；周期性的。

entries.definition: a round shape or a group of people. It is the shape, not the repetition.
entries.definitionCN: 圆形，或一圈人。它指形状，不指重复。

entries.definition: a path that curves back to its start. It often implies a trap or a repeated action.
entries.definitionCN: 弯回起点的路径。它常暗示陷阱或重复动作。

entries.definition: the act of turning around a centre. It is the motion of one cycle, not the whole series.
entries.definitionCN: 绕中心转动的动作。它是循环中的一次运动，而不是整个序列。

entries.definition: a regular repeated pattern of sound or movement. It stresses timing, not return to a start.
entries.definitionCN: 声音或运动中规律的重复模式。它强调时间感，而不是回到起点。

normalIntro.en: Real morphology: Greek kyklos 'wheel' gives cycle, bicycle, cyclone, cyclic and recycle. The wheel is visible in every member of the family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词：希腊语 kyklos“车轮”给出 cycle、bicycle、cyclone、cyclic、recycle。轮子在这个词族的每个成员里都看得见。

normal.en: kyklos means wheel. A cycle is events on a wheel: after the last, the first returns.
normal.cn: kyklos 意为车轮。cycle 就是轮子上的事件：最后一个之后，第一个又回来。

normal.en: bicycle is 'two wheels', and cycle is the short form. The vehicle is named after the same wheel as the abstract cycle.
normal.cn: bicycle 是“两个轮子”，cycle 是缩略形式。这种交通工具和抽象的 cycle 用的是同一个“轮”。

normal.en: Life cycle, economic cycle and engine cycle all require a return to the starting state.
normal.cn: life cycle、economic cycle、engine cycle 都要求回到初始状态。

normal.en: A vicious cycle is a wheel that pushes itself: each turn makes the next turn worse.
normal.cn: 恶性循环是一个自我推动的轮子：每一圈都让下一圈更糟。

normal.en: Recycle puts the circle back into material use: the same material goes round again.
normal.cn: recycle 把圆环放回物质使用：同一种材料再转一圈。

abstract.en: Picture the contact point of a wheel. It touches the ground, lifts, travels through the air, and touches the same kind of spot again.
abstract.cn: 想象车轮的接地点。它接触地面、抬起、在空中前进，然后又落在同类的位置上。

abstract.en: A spiral goes up but never returns; a cycle is the shape that insists on return.
abstract.cn: 螺旋向上却从不返回；cycle 是那种坚持“回来”的形状。

abstract.en: A washing machine drum is a cycle you can watch: fill, turn, drain, and stop where it began.
abstract.cn: 洗衣机的滚筒是一个看得见的循环：进水、转动、排水，最后停回开始的地方。

examples.en: The water cycle moves moisture from ocean to cloud to rain.
examples.cn: 水循环把水汽从海洋送到云层，再变成雨。

examples.en: The economy is in the late stage of a long cycle.
examples.cn: 经济正处于一个长周期的后段。

examples.en: He cycles to the lab when the weather is dry.
examples.cn: 天气干燥时他骑车去实验室。

dict_mnemonic.text: “赛扣”——赛扣骑着车绕操场一圈，又回到起点 → cycle 循环、自行车

root: 希腊语 kyklos“圆、车轮”，核心是“转一圈又回到起点”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of cycle, all one wheel: a repeating series, one round, a self-feeding loop, a life cycle, an economic cycle, an engine cycle, a bicycle, riding it, and a system cycling through states.
sensesIntro.cn: cycle 的九个义项都是同一个车轮：重复序列、一圈、自我喂养的循环、生命周期、经济周期、发动机循环、自行车、骑车，以及系统在状态间循环。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wheel turns and its contact point returns to the same kind of place.
core.cn: 核心意象：车轮转动，接地点回到同类的位置。

branches.en: TIME: a repeating series and one full turn of it.
branches.cn: 时间：重复的序列，以及它的一整圈。

branches.en: TRAP: a loop that feeds itself becomes vicious.
branches.cn: 陷阱：自我喂养的环会变成恶性循环。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: life, economy and engines all return to a starting state.
branches.cn: 系统：生命、经济与发动机都回到初始状态。

branches.en: WHEELS: the bicycle is the literal wheel, and riding it is the verb.
branches.cn: 车轮：自行车是字面上的轮子，骑车是它的动词。

branches.en: PROCESS: a machine cycles through a fixed sequence.
branches.cn: 过程：机器沿固定序列循环。

intro.en: cycle takes -ic and -ical for adjectives, -ist for the rider, and re- for recycle. The Greek root kyklos is the wheel inside all of them.
intro.cn: cycle 加 -ic 和 -ical 构成形容词，加 -ist 表示骑车人，加 re- 构成 recycle。希腊词根 kyklos 就是它们里面的那个轮子。

latinIntro.en: The family comes from Greek kyklos 'wheel': bicycle, cyclone, cyclic, recycle and encyclopedia (the 'circle of learning') all carry it.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族来自希腊语 kyklos“车轮”：bicycle、cyclone、cyclic、recycle、encyclopedia（“学习的圆圈”）都带着它。

items.meaning: happening in a repeating cycle
items.meaningCN: 循环的；环状的（-ic 表示“与……有关”）
items.example: Cyclic changes in sea temperature affect fish.
items.exampleCN: 海水温度的周期性变化会影响鱼类。

items.meaning: recurring in cycles, especially in economics
items.meaningCN: 周期性的（-ical 构成形容词，常用于经济）
items.example: The industry is exposed to cyclical demand.
items.exampleCN: 这个行业受周期性需求影响。

items.meaning: a person who rides a bicycle
items.meaningCN: 骑自行车的人（-ist 表示做该动作的人）
items.example: The cyclist stopped at the red light.
items.exampleCN: 骑车人在红灯前停下。

items.meaning: to process used material so it can be used again
items.meaningCN: 回收利用（再转一圈）
items.example: The city recycles glass and paper.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市回收玻璃和纸张。

items.meaning: a two-wheeled vehicle
items.meaningCN: 自行车（bi-“二”+ kyklos“轮”）
items.example: He rides a bicycle to the station.
items.exampleCN: 他骑自行车去车站。

items.meaning: a rotating storm system
items.meaningCN: 气旋；旋风（与 kyklos“轮”同根）
items.example: The cyclone turned away from the coast.
items.exampleCN: 气旋转向离开了海岸。

items.meaning: a work covering the whole circle of knowledge
items.meaningCN: 百科全书（“学习的圆圈”）
items.example: The shelf holds an old encyclopedia.
items.exampleCN: 书架上放着一套旧百科全书。

items.meaning: the process of using something again
items.meaningCN: 回收利用（-ing 构成动名词）
items.example: Recycling cuts the waste stream.
items.exampleCN: 回收利用减少了废物流。

items.meaning: in repeating cycles
items.meaningCN: 周期性地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The lake level rises cyclically.
items.exampleCN: 湖水水位周期性上升。

latinEntries.meaning: a two-wheeled vehicle
latinEntries.meaningCN: 自行车（两个轮子）

latinEntries.meaning: a rotating storm system
latinEntries.meaningCN: 气旋（旋转的风暴）

latinEntries.meaning: the 'circle of learning', a comprehensive reference work
latinEntries.meaningCN: 百科全书（“学习的圆圈”）

latinEntries.meaning: a one-wheeled vehicle
latinEntries.meaningCN: 独轮车（一个轮子）

definition_zh: 数据；资料；（datum 的复数）事实依据
definition_en: plural of datum: facts, measurements, or information used for analysis, especially in digital form
core_image: 一筐已经给出的事实，等着被数、被比较
scene: 实验台上，传感器记录了一整晚的读数。 The student imported a whole night of data from the sensor into a table, and the curve showed a clear pattern.
sceneCN: 这里 data 是「数据」（第 1 个义项：用于分析的事实与测量结果，复数）；句意：学生把传感器记录的一整晚数据导入表格，曲线显出清晰的规律。

pos.zh: 数据；资料（datum 的复数；现代英语常作集合名词）

derivatives.zh: 数据项；基准面（单数形式）

senses.title: Facts used for reasoning
senses.definition: facts or information given before an analysis, from which conclusions are drawn
senses.definitionCN: 分析之前已经给出、用来得出结论的事实或信息
senses.example: The data support the hypothesis.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数据支持该假说。
senses.why: Latin datum meant 'something given', the past participle of dare 'to give'. Data are literally the given facts, handed to the mind before it interprets them.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 datum 意为“被给出的东西”，是 dare“给”的过去分词。data 字面上就是“被给出的事实”，在头脑解释之前先交到头脑手里。

senses.title: Digital information
senses.definition: information stored and processed by computers, such as files, records, or signals
senses.definitionCN: 由计算机存储和处理的信息，如文件、记录或信号
senses.example: The app stores data on your phone.
senses.exampleCN: 这个应用把数据存在你的手机里。
senses.why: The given facts now live as bits. Computing adopted 'data' in the 1940s because machine input is, quite literally, what is given to the machine.
senses.whyCN: 被给出的事实现在以比特形式存在。计算机领域在 20 世纪 40 年代采用 data，因为机器输入字面上就是“交给机器的东西”。

senses.title: Measurements and research results
senses.definition: observations, readings, or results collected during research
senses.definitionCN: 研究中收集的观察、读数或结果
senses.example: The team collected data for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 团队收集了三年数据。
senses.why: Instruments 'give' readings to the researcher. The word keeps its passive shape: the data are received, not invented.
senses.whyCN: 仪器把读数“给”研究者。这个词保留被动形态：数据是被接收的，不是被发明出来的。

senses.title: Mass-noun usage: 'the data is'
senses.titleCN: 集合名词用法：the data is
senses.definition: in modern English, data is often treated as an uncountable mass noun and takes a singular verb, although the plural verb is standard in formal writing
senses.definitionCN: 现代英语常把 data 当作不可数集合名词、接单数动词，尽管正式写作中复数动词才是标准
senses.example: The data is incomplete.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数据不完整。
senses.why: Latin plural data behaves like a mass in everyday English, the way 'information' does. Formal science writing still prefers 'the data are', because the Latin plural is visible in the form.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语复数 data 在日常英语里表现得像不可数物质，正如 information。正式科学写作仍偏好 the data are，因为拉丁语复数在词形上看得见。

senses.title: Singular datum
senses.definition: a single piece of data; in surveying, a fixed reference point or plane
senses.definitionCN: 一条数据；在测量中，固定的参考点或基准面
senses.example: Each datum was checked twice, and the data were rebuilt from the raw records.
senses.exampleCN: 每个数据点都核对了两遍，整份数据由原始记录重建。
senses.why: datum is the Latin singular and survives in technical writing. Surveying uses datum for a fixed reference plane, which is also a 'given' point.
senses.whyCN: datum 是拉丁语单数，在技术写作中保留下来。测量学用 datum 表示固定参考面，那也是一个“被给出的”基准点。

senses.title: Personal data
senses.definition: information about an identifiable person, protected by privacy law
senses.definitionCN: 关于可识别个人的信息，受隐私法保护
senses.example: Companies must protect personal data.
senses.exampleCN: 公司必须保护个人数据。
senses.why: A person 'gives' information about themselves, and the law treats that gift as something that still belongs to them. The legal sense makes the 'given' nature of data a matter of rights.
senses.whyCN: 个人把自己的信息“给出”，法律却把这份给予当作仍属于本人的东西。法律义让 data 的“被给出”性质变成了权利问题。

senses.title: Data science and data analysis
senses.definition: the field or activity of extracting patterns and decisions from collected data
senses.definitionCN: 从收集的数据中提取模式与决策的领域或活动
senses.example: Data science blends statistics and computing.
senses.exampleCN: 数据科学结合了统计学与计算。
senses.why: Data science treats the given facts as raw material, then extracts patterns from them. The field name keeps the passive sense: data are given first, and conclusions come later.
senses.whyCN: 数据科学把被给出的事实当作原料，再从中提取模式。这个领域名称保留了被动义：先有被给出的数据，之后才有结论。

senses.title: Raw versus processed data
senses.titleCN: 原始数据与处理后数据
senses.definition: data as first recorded, before cleaning or transformation, as opposed to data that has been processed
senses.definitionCN: 最初记录、尚未清洗或转换的数据，相对于已经处理过的数据
senses.example: Raw data must be cleaned before analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 原始数据在分析前必须清洗。
senses.why: Raw data are the gift as it arrived; processed data are the gift after sorting. The same word covers both stages, so the modifier does the work.
senses.whyCN: raw data 是刚到手时的礼物；processed data 是整理之后的礼物。同一个词覆盖两个阶段，所以由修饰语来区分。

senses.title: Data point
senses.definition: a single observation or value plotted or counted in an analysis
senses.definitionCN: 分析中被绘制或计数的一次观察或一个数值
senses.example: Each survey response is one data point.
senses.exampleCN: 每份问卷回答就是一个数据点。
senses.why: A point is the smallest visible unit on a graph, and a datum is the smallest given fact. The compound joins the two images.
senses.whyCN: 点（point）是图表上最小的可见单位，datum 是最小的“被给出的事实”。这个复合词把两个意象接在一起。

senses.title: Data-driven
senses.definition: in the compound data-driven, decided or guided by collected evidence rather than intuition
senses.definitionCN: 复合词 data-driven 表示由收集的证据而非直觉来决定或引导
senses.example: A data-driven decision cites evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 数据驱动的决策会引用证据。
senses.why: The compound turns data into a steering force: the given facts drive the choice. It is the modern managerial version of 'the facts decide'.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把 data 变成一种操控力：被给出的事实驱动选择。它是“让事实决定”的现代管理版本。

intro.en: Data is not an English plural built with -s. It is the Latin plural of datum 'a thing given', from dare 'to give'. In modern English it is often treated as a mass noun, but the Latin plural still explains the form.
intro.cn: data 不是用 -s 构成的英语复数。它是 datum“被给出的东西”的拉丁语复数，来自 dare“给”。现代英语常把它当作集合名词，但拉丁语复数仍解释了这个词形。

items.en: First recorded in English in mathematics and philosophy as the plural of datum, meaning 'things given' or 'facts granted'.
items.cn: 17 世纪 40 年代最早记录于英语的数学与哲学，作为 datum 的复数，意为“被给出的东西”或“被承认的事实”。

items.en: datum is the neuter past participle of dare 'to give', used as a noun: 'a thing given'.
items.cn: datum 是 dare“给”的中性过去分词，作名词用，意为“被给出的东西”。

items.en: datum is a second-declension neuter noun; its plural is data. The -a is therefore a Latin plural ending, not an English one.
items.cn: datum 是第二变格法中性名词，复数为 data。因此 -a 是拉丁语复数词尾，不是英语词尾。

items.en: dare is traced to PIE *do- 'to give'. The reconstruction is generally accepted. English date (the calendar word) also comes from data, in the phrase data Romae 'given at Rome'.
items.cn: dare 被追溯到原始印欧语 *do-“给”，该重构属于一般认为是。英语的 date（日期）也来自 data，出自短语 data Romae“于罗马发出”。

items.en: Science adopts data for the facts on which reasoning is based. The singular datum survives in surveying and measurement.
items.cn: 科学采用 data 表示推理所依据的事实。单数 datum 在测量与计量中保留下来。

items.en: Computing makes data machine-readable in the 1940s; database, dataset and metadata follow; personal data becomes a legal category in the late 20c.
items.cn: 计算领域在 20 世纪 40 年代让 data 变成机器可读；database、dataset、metadata 随后出现；personal data 在 20 世纪晚期成为法律类别。

note.en: The first group shares datum 'given thing' or looks close; the second group separates information, statistics, evidence and bare facts.
note.cn: 第一组共享 datum“被给出的东西”或词形接近；第二组区分信息、统计、证据和裸事实。

entries.definition: one piece of data; also a fixed reference point in surveying.
entries.definitionCN: 一条数据；测量中也是固定基准点。

entries.definition: an organised collection of data that can be searched and updated.
entries.definitionCN: 可检索、可更新的有组织数据集合。

entries.definition: the day, month, or year of an event. It comes from Latin data in the phrase 'given at Rome'.
entries.definitionCN: 事件发生的日、月或年。它来自拉丁语 data，出自短语“于罗马发出”。

entries.definition: facts that have been organised or interpreted. It is often the result of processing data.
entries.definitionCN: 经过组织或解释的事实。它常是处理数据后的结果。

entries.definition: numerical data collected and analysed in a systematic way; also the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 系统收集和分析的数值数据；也指统计学。

entries.definition: facts or objects used to prove a claim. It stresses the role in an argument, not the form.
entries.definitionCN: 用于证明主张的事实或物件。它强调在论证中的角色，而不是形式。

entries.definition: things that are known to be true. They are what data are supposed to record.
entries.definitionCN: 已知为真的事情。它们是数据本应记录的东西。

normalIntro.en: Real morphology: Latin dare 'to give' gives datum (given thing), data (given things), and even date (given at Rome). The plural is Latin -a.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词：拉丁语 dare“给”给出 datum（被给出的东西）、data（被给出的东西们），甚至 date（于罗马发出）。复数是拉丁语 -a。

normal.en: datum means 'given'. Data are the facts given to you before you explain them.
normal.cn: datum 意为“被给出的”。data 就是在你解释之前交到你手里的事实。

normal.en: Data is the plural of datum, so formal writing says 'the data are'; everyday English often says 'the data is'.
normal.cn: data 是 datum 的复数，所以正式写作用 the data are；日常英语常说 the data is。

normal.en: Date comes from data in 'given at Rome': a document's date is when and where it was given.
normal.cn: date 来自 data，出自“于罗马发出”：文件的日期就是它被发出的时间与地点。

normal.en: A database is a container of given facts; a data point is the smallest one.
normal.cn: database 是装“被给出的事实”的容器；data point 是其中最小的一条。

normal.en: Raw data is the gift as it arrives; processed data is the gift after sorting.
normal.cn: 原始数据是刚到手时的礼物；处理后数据是整理之后的礼物。

abstract.en: Picture a basket handed to you before you start thinking. Whatever is in it is data; what you build with it is a conclusion.
abstract.cn: 想象在你开始思考之前，有人递给你一只篮子。篮子里的东西就是数据；你用它们搭出来的才是结论。

abstract.en: Data is a plural word wearing a singular mask. The grammar argument is really about whether you still hear the Latin.
abstract.cn: data 是一个戴着单数面具的复数词。语法争论的本质是：你还能不能听见拉丁语。

abstract.en: A river of numbers flows into a chart, but the chart is not the river; it is a shape cut from it.
abstract.cn: 一条数字之河流进图表，但图表不是河本身，只是从河里截出的一个形状。

examples.en: The data were collected from twelve schools.
examples.cn: 这些数据来自十二所学校。

examples.en: Personal data must be stored securely.
examples.cn: 个人数据必须安全存储。

examples.en: The decision was data-driven rather than emotional.
examples.cn: 这个决定是数据驱动的，而不是情绪化的。

dict_mnemonic.text: “得他”——得他先把一堆事实交出来，才谈得上分析 → data 数据、资料

root: 拉丁语 dare“给”的过去分词 datum“被给出的东西”，复数 data，核心是“先被交到手里、再拿来分析的事实”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of data, all one gift of facts: given facts, digital information, measurements, mass-noun usage, the singular datum, personal data, data science, raw versus processed, a data point, and data-driven.
sensesIntro.cn: data 的十个义项都是同一份“事实之礼”：被给出的事实、数字信息、测量结果、集合名词用法、单数 datum、个人数据、数据科学、原始与处理后、数据点，以及数据驱动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a basket of facts is handed over before interpretation begins.
core.cn: 核心意象：在解释开始之前，一篮事实先被交到手里。

branches.en: GIVEN: facts and measurements are received before they are explained.
branches.cn: 被给出：事实与测量在被解释之前先被接收。

branches.en: DIGITAL: machine input is literally what is given to the machine, and a field grows around it.
branches.cn: 数字：机器输入字面上就是交给机器的东西，一个领域围绕它成长。

branches.en: GRAMMAR: the Latin plural datum/data meets the modern mass-noun usage.
branches.cn: 语法：拉丁语复数 datum/data 与现代集合名词用法相遇。

branches.en: PERSONAL: data about a person is given but still belongs to that person.
branches.cn: 个人：关于个人的数据虽被给出，却仍属于该个人。

branches.en: WORK: raw, processed, pointed and driving — data as material for decisions.
branches.cn: 工作：原始、处理后、数据点与驱动——作为决策材料的数据。

intro.en: data itself has no English affix. Its plural -a is Latin, and its compounds (database, dataset, metadata) add English or Greek prefixes to the same root.
intro.cn: data 本身没有英语词缀。它的复数 -a 是拉丁语词尾，它的复合词（database、dataset、metadata）在同一个词根上加英语或希腊语前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on dare 'to give': datum, data, date and tradition (handed over) all describe something given from one party to another.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 dare“给”上：datum、data、date、tradition（传下来）都描述从一方交给另一方的东西。

items.meaning: a single given fact; a fixed reference point
items.meaningCN: 单数形式：一条给定事实；固定基准点
items.example: The surveyor fixed the datum before measuring.
items.exampleCN: 测量员在测量前先确定基准面。

items.meaning: an organised store of data that can be searched
items.meaningCN: 数据库（可检索的有组织数据存储）
items.example: The database holds ten years of records.
items.exampleCN: 这个数据库保存了十年记录。

items.meaning: a collection of related data treated as one unit
items.meaningCN: 数据集（作为一个单位处理的相关数据集合）
items.example: The dataset contains images and labels.
items.exampleCN: 这个数据集包含图像和标签。

items.meaning: data that describes other data
items.meaningCN: 元数据（描述其他数据的数据）
items.example: Metadata records when and where a photo was taken.
items.exampleCN: 元数据记录照片拍摄的时间和地点。

items.meaning: guided by evidence rather than guesswork
items.meaningCN: 数据驱动的（复合形容词）
items.example: The lab adopted a data-driven method.
items.exampleCN: 实验室采用了数据驱动的方法。

items.meaning: a document listing the specifications of a product
items.meaningCN: 数据表；规格表（复合名词）
items.example: The engineer checked the datasheet first.
items.exampleCN: 工程师先查了规格表。

items.meaning: an organized store of information
items.meaningCN: 数据库；资料库（复合名词）
items.example: The databank holds forty years of records.
items.exampleCN: 这个资料库存有四十年的记录。

items.meaning: more than one collected set of data
items.meaningCN: 多个数据集（-s 构成复数）
items.example: The model was trained on three datasets.
items.exampleCN: 这个模型用三个数据集训练。

latinEntries.structure: data (given), from data Romae 'given at Rome'
latinEntries.meaning: the time of an event or document
latinEntries.meaningCN: 日期（文件“于罗马发出”的时间）

latinEntries.meaning: something handed down from one generation to another
latinEntries.meaningCN: 传统（一代代交下来的东西）

latinEntries.meaning: to give something, especially to a cause
latinEntries.meaningCN: 捐赠（给出）

latinEntries.structure: Greek dosis (a giving), from didonai 'to give'
latinEntries.meaning: an amount of medicine given at one time
latinEntries.meaningCN: 剂量（一次给出的药量）
